howToUse: Send a synthetic bundle; pick a PAS version or take the default.
safeToRun: Synthetic data only. Body cap 2 MB, 10 calls a minute. Free; no account, no key.
A result too long to send whole keeps its findings 1 hour for get_validation_findings.
The bundle itself is never kept.
whatItDoes: Checks a bundle against the pinned PAS guide.
Returns an OperationOutcome with a coverage note first.
Over MCP, a result too long to send whole comes back summarised: coverage, counts, the top findings.
whatItIs: The ImOnFHIR validator for Da Vinci PAS Submit Bundles.

description: Validate a synthetic Da Vinci PAS Submit Bundle with the ImOnFHIR validator. Synthetic payloads only. Never send real patient data. Findings describe a synthetic Bundle. Body cap 2 MB, 10 calls per minute. Over MCP every answer carries `verdict`: the validator's own readiness verdict, the one its Lab shows (readiness, a one-sentence statement, its readiness dimensions and its consolidated counts); read it first. Then `summary`: false means the whole OperationOutcome is in `outcome`; true means it was over 100,000 characters, so the answer is a bounded summary instead (the coverage note; distinct problems by severity, a problem the validator's layers report twice counted once, with the raw counts beside them; counts by issue code, rule family and resource; the PAS profile versions the issues cite; the 25 most serious kinds of finding, and how many were not listed). A summary's findings (never the bundle) are kept 1 hour: get_validation_findings pages every issue with the result_id it gives. POST /api/v1/validate returns the whole OperationOutcome.

version.description: A PAS version the validator allows; omitted, the default.

name: validate_bundle

by_severity.description: As reported: one per OperationOutcome issue, as REST returns them; larger than problems_by_severity when layers report the same problem.

problems.description: Distinct problems: one per severity, code, message and place, so a problem two validator layers report counts once. Lead with this.

count.description: Issues of this kind as reported, layer twins included.

places.description: Distinct places this kind occurs: its problems, layer twins merged.

outcome.description: Present only when summary is false.

result_id.description: The id get_validation_findings reads; null when the result could not be kept (see store_note).

summary.description: false: the whole OperationOutcome is in outcome. true: it was too long to send whole; this is a bounded summary.

verdict.description: The validator product's own readiness verdict, the one its Lab shows; read verdict.statement first.

terminology.description: off_on_this_site: this site does not check codes against terminology, by design, so no bundle reads Ready.

title: Validate a PAS bundle
